# QuotaPin 1.1.1

QuotaPin 1.1.1 makes long-running quota delivery and user-approved updates recover cleanly without restarting Codex.

- **Live quota recovery:** a disconnected CDP socket is replaced even when Codex keeps the same target id, and an unresponsive App Server child is retired instead of leaving an old percentage on screen.
- **One update path:** the panel and Windows tray now use the same resumable, identity-verifying update transaction instead of maintaining separate downloaders.
- **Installation mode preserved:** updates retain the existing quiet watcher or guided tray setup rather than silently converting one into the other.
- **Visible progress:** the editor exposes an update entry, manual refresh, last verified check, and preparation, download, verification, installation, and reconnection phases.
- **Better network recovery:** successful release checks are cached for six hours; temporary failures keep the last verified result and retry with bounded backoff beginning after 15 minutes.
- **No forced Codex restart:** the updater reattaches only to the exact verified running session. If that proof is unavailable, the new version waits for the next normal Codex launch.
- **Configuration preserved:** repair and update keep saved views, layout, language, appearance, and launch preference.

Windows Quick Start:

The guided Windows package is `QuotaPin-1.1.1.exe`.

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

macOS Quick Start:

The macOS package is `QuotaPin-macOS-1.1.1.dmg`.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install-macos.sh | bash
```

Windows requires x64 Windows 10 version 2004 or later; Windows 11 is verified and Windows 10 remains best effort. Windows ARM64 is not supported. The macOS package is ad-hoc signed and CI-validated; signed-in real-device and Gatekeeper acceptance remains provisional.
